Market today: The market is cautious today, driven by a hot jobs report that's boosting expectations for higher Fed interest rates. This puts pressure on growth-oriented tech and chip names, as higher rates make future earnings less attractive and increase borrowing costs.

Your holdings: SOXL is down 53.92% and SPAL, a brand-new, very volatile IPO, is down 33.48%. Both are leveraged ETFs, and trading them on margin amplifies these drops significantly. These positions need immediate attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the Fed's stance on interest rates, as this will heavily influence your tech-heavy portfolio. Also, monitor your leveraged SOXL and SPAL positions for further decay or downside.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged, underperforming positions aggressively while navigating a potentially higher-rate environment.
plays: SOXL and SPAL are deeply in the red and leveraged. Consider trimming or exiting these positions to reduce margin risk and exposure to decay.
Oracle (ORCL) has positive news and a scanner setup. Consider a new buy at 157.38-157.16 with a stop at 156.47, but be aware of earnings volatility.
